linked_prs.title: enhance: Workflow better filenames and custom session id
linked_prs.body:
## Description

fixes #3277
The new fix must enable:
1. using custom sessions ids
2. use role_name of the agent as the filename, and if not provided, use the `task_title` in the workflow summary. doesn't use description anymore due to long names.
